value_stream.name: Supply Chain Finance & Working Capital Management

fields.Participants: Treasury Manager, AP Manager, Procurement, Vendor (links to VS-03.4), IT (links to VS-27.2)
fields.Trigger: SCF program launch (links to W3377); annual curve refresh

workflows.name: Dynamic-Discounting Platform Setup, Discount-Curve Design & Vendor Enrollment

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-count of "Treasury Manager design the dynamic-discounting curve" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System rule-based auto-approval of "Treasury/IT configure the dynamic-discounting module on the AP/SCF platform" (replaces manual Step 2).
Controls: - CTL-545 (ensure controlled execution — Dynamic Discounting & Early-Payment Operations (PA-105.2).)
- operational: annual calibration to cost-of-funds and analytics (W3388); operational: IT testing and reconciliation (W3392)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Curve-miscalibration risk**: Over-generous curve erodes yield; too-tight curve starves adoption; mitigated by annual calibration to cost-of-funds and analytics (W3388)
- **Integration-break risk**: AP feed/platform disconnect halts offers; mitigated by IT testing and reconciliation (W3392)
System Touchpoints: - Dynamic-discounting / SCF platform; AP (links to VS-15.1); supplier portal (links to VS-03.4); GL (links to VS-17.1); treasury yield reference (links to VS-18.3/W318)

steps.activity: Treasury Manager design the dynamic-discounting curve: discount % as a function of days-early (e.g., 2%/10, 1%/20, 0.5%/30 vs Net 45 standard), calibrated to BuildRight's cost of funds (links to VS-18.3/W319), vendor margin tolerance (links to VS-39), and the risk-free alternative (links to VS-18 short-term investment yield W318)

Treasury/IT configure the dynamic-discounting module on the AP/SCF platform: approved-payable feed (links to VS-15.1), curve engine, vendor enrollment flag, payment-method/routing, and GL mapping for discount income (links to VS-17.1); integrate and test end-to-end

Procurement enroll vendors into dynamic discounting via the supplier portal (links to VS-03.4): explain the sliding-scale offer, opt-in, set floor/ceiling, and confirm bank account; segment vendors by discount sensitivity and prioritize high-yield targets

workflows.name: Sliding-Scale Early-Payment Offer Generation & Vendor Acceptance

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-count of "discount % for each early-payment date derived from the curve" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-review of "reviews and accepts an offer" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-monitor of "monitor offer-to-acceptance conversion, yield capture, and vendor participation" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-545 (ensure controlled execution — Dynamic Discounting & Early-Payment Operations (PA-105.2).)
- operational: vendor outreach and curve tuning (W3388); operational: offer-threshold and throttling (W3389)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Low-acceptance risk**: Vendors ignore offers, leaving yield uncaptured; mitigated by vendor outreach and curve tuning (W3388)
- **Offer-leakage risk**: Offers generated on invoices already near-due yield negligible discount; mitigated by offer-threshold and throttling (W3389)
System Touchpoints: - Dynamic-discounting platform; supplier portal (links to VS-03.4); AP payment run (links to VS-15.2); analytics (links to VS-28.1)

steps.activity: AP/Platform auto-generate the sliding-scale early-payment offer on each approved, enrolled invoice: discount % for each early-payment date derived from the curve (W3385); present to vendor via the supplier portal (links to VS-03.4) with net amount, discount, and effective date

Vendor reviews and accepts an offer (selects payment date) or declines (pays at standard term); system captures acceptance, locks the discount and payment date, and removes the payable from the standard payment run (links to VS-15.2)
AP/Treasury monitor offer-to-acceptance conversion, yield capture, and vendor participation; flag low-adoption vendors for Procurement outreach (W3385) and tune the curve based on analytics (W3388)

fields.Participants: AP Manager, Treasury Manager, Bank (links to VS-18.2), Vendor
fields.Trigger: Vendor offer acceptance (W3386); scheduled early-payment date

workflows.name: Self-Funded Early-Payment Execution, Funding & Bank Settlement

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-validate of "validate cash availability with Treasury" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-record of "records the discount-captured income and clears the payable" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-count of "AP/Treasury reconcile the early-payment settlement to the bank statement" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - operational: cash-availability validation (W3389); operational: payable-flag removal and reconciliation (W3392)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Cash-shortfall risk**: Funding early payments without cash check drains operating accounts; mitigated by cash-availability validation (W3389)
- **Duplicate-payment risk**: Paying early AND in the standard run; mitigated by payable-flag removal and reconciliation (W3392)
System Touchpoints: - Dynamic-discounting platform; bank/payment file (links to VS-18.2); AP/GL (links to VS-15.2/VS-17.1); cash positioning (links to VS-18.1)

steps.activity: AP/Platform compile the daily early-payment batch: accepted offers due today, net amount (face − discount), vendor bank routing, and entity/bank account (multi-entity per VS-72); validate cash availability with Treasury (W3389)

Treasury confirm funding source (operating account vs sweep per VS-18.2/W323) and release the payment file; bank executes the early payment to the vendor; AP/Platform records the discount-captured income and clears the payable

AP/Treasury reconcile the early-payment settlement to the bank statement (links to VS-18.2), confirm discount-income posting (links to VS-17.1), and resolve exceptions (W3383); report daily discount capture to Treasury

fields.Participants: Treasury Manager, FP&A (links to VS-17.4), Procurement
fields.Trigger: Weekly/monthly yield review; annual curve refresh (W3385)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-count of "Treasury/Analytics compute the effective APR/yield of captured discounts" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-identify of "identify yield leakage" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-review of "Treasury Manager present yield analytics and recommendations to the" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - operational: APR monitoring and curve calibration; operational: granular analytics
Pain Points / Risks: - **Negative-yield risk**: Paying early at a discount below the cost of funds destroys value; mitigated by APR monitoring and curve calibration
- **Analytics-blindspot risk**: Aggregate yield masks per-vendor leakage; mitigated by granular analytics
System Touchpoints: - Dynamic-discounting analytics; BI/treasury dashboards (links to VS-28.1); FP&A (links to VS-17.4)

steps.activity: Treasury/Analytics compute the effective APR/yield of captured discounts (discount $ ÷ face ÷ days-early × 365) by vendor, segment, and curve-band; benchmark against BuildRight's cost of funds (links to VS-18.3/W319) and short-term investment yield (links to W318) to confirm discounting beats the alternative

Treasury/Procurement identify yield leakage (low-yield acceptances, curve over-payment, concentration) and high-yield opportunities (untapped vendors, curve tightening); recommend curve/vendor changes and rebalance enrollment
Treasury Manager present yield analytics and recommendations to the SCF governance review (W3384) and feed outcomes to the working-capital dashboard (W3399); update the curve per W3385 as needed

fields.Trigger: Daily cash-position review (links to VS-18.1); liquidity event

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-review of "review the daily cash position and short-term forecast" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-import of "Treasury set/adjust the daily early-payment throttle" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-escalate of "escalate over-throttle high-value acceptances to Treasury/CFO for ad-hoc…" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-545 (ensure controlled execution — Dynamic Discounting & Early-Payment Operations (PA-105.2).)
- operational: daily throttle tied to forecast; operational: dynamic, forecast-aware throttling
Pain Points / Risks: - **Liquidity-drain risk**: Unthrottled early payment during a cash squeeze triggers overdraft/borrowing; mitigated by daily throttle tied to forecast
- **Yield-starvation risk**: Over-throttling in normal periods leaves yield uncaptured; mitigated by dynamic, forecast-aware throttling
System Touchpoints: - Cash positioning/forecast (links to VS-18.1); dynamic-discounting platform throttle; AP (links to VS-15); treasury sweeps (links to VS-18.2/W323)

steps.activity: Treasury review the daily cash position and short-term forecast (links to VS-18.1/W233): operating balance, sweep availability (W323), capex draw needs (links to VS-40), tax/statutory outflows (links to VS-79), and import/LC settlements (links to VS-02.2); compute the early-payment funding envelope

Treasury set/adjust the daily early-payment throttle (cap, vendor-tier, curve-band) based on cash availability; throttle down in tight-liquidity periods (e.g., pre-VAT/statutory remittance, import-LC week) and up in surplus periods

AP execute within the throttle, escalate over-throttle high-value acceptances to Treasury/CFO for ad-hoc authorization (links to W3390), and report throttling impact on yield capture to the weekly review (W3388)

fields.Participants: AP Manager, Treasury Manager, Vendor, Procurement
fields.Trigger: Vendor early-payment request via portal (links to VS-03.4)

workflows.name: Vendor-Initiated Early-Payment Request & Ad-Hoc Discount Approval

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-count of "raises an ad-hoc early-payment request" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-log of "assess the request" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-review of "execute the approved ad-hoc early payment" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-545 (ensure controlled execution — Dynamic Discounting & Early-Payment Operations (PA-105.2).)
- operational: health assessment and escalation (links to VS-68); operational: authority limits and curve realignment
Pain Points / Risks: - **Distress-masking risk**: Repeated ad-hoc requests may signal vendor insolvency; mitigated by health assessment and escalation (links to VS-68)
- **Inconsistent-pricing risk**: Ad-hoc discounts diverge from the curve; mitigated by authority limits and curve realignment
System Touchpoints: - Supplier portal (links to VS-03.4); dynamic-discounting platform; AP/GL (links to VS-15/VS-17.1)

steps.activity: Vendor raises an ad-hoc early-payment request via the supplier portal outside the auto-offer curve (e.g., distress, working-capital need); AP/Treasury receive the request with invoice, amount, requested date, and proposed discount

Treasury/Procurement assess the request: vendor health/strategic importance (links to VS-67), discount vs curve/yield (W3388), cash availability (W3389), and any distress signal warranting escalation (links to VS-68 trade-credit-risk methodology); approve, counter, or decline within SLA
AP execute the approved ad-hoc early payment, post the agreed discount (W3392), and log the request outcome for governance (W3384); feed repeat ad-hoc patterns into curve/enrollment review (W3385)

fields.Participants: Treasury Manager, AP (per entity), Intercompany/Shared Services (links to VS-72), Vendor
fields.Trigger: Multi-entity AP (Depot, Logistics, Digital Commerce entities per profile §2); intercompany vendor invoicing

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-count of "discounting across the 5 entities" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-log of "Treasury/Shared Services handle intercompany vendor invoicing" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-reconcile of "reconcile entity-level cash impact to the cash forecast" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-545 (ensure controlled execution — Dynamic Discounting & Early-Payment Operations (PA-105.2).)
- operational: entity-aware platform config and reconciliation; operational: exclusion rules and coordination
Pain Points / Risks: - **Entity-allocation-error risk**: Wrong-entity discount/finance-cost posting distorts entity P&L; mitigated by entity-aware platform config and reconciliation
- **Intercompany-timing risk**: Early payment on intercompany invoices distorts elimination; mitigated by exclusion rules and coordination
System Touchpoints: - Multi-entity AP/GL (links to VS-17.1/VS-17.2); intercompany (links to VS-72); SCF platform; transfer pricing (links to VS-17.2/W305)

steps.activity: Treasury/AP coordinate SCF/dynamic-discounting across the 5 entities: vendor enrollment maps to multiple entity payables, facility limit/curve apply group-wide, and each entity's payables feed the platform; reconcile to entity AP sub-ledgers

Treasury/Shared Services handle intercompany vendor invoicing (e.g., Logistics entity charges Depot entity per profile §2): ensure discount eligibility, payment term, and SCF treatment are consistent and that intercompany elimination (links to VS-17.2/W234) is unaffected by early-payment timing

Treasury allocate finance cost/discount income to the correct entity per transfer-pricing policy (links to VS-17.2/W235/VS-72), reconcile entity-level cash impact to the cash forecast (links to VS-18.1), and report group-wide working-capital outcome (W3393)

fields.Participants: AP Manager, Treasury Manager, Finance/GL (links to VS-17.1), Internal Audit (links to VS-21)
fields.Trigger: Daily batch close; month-end close (links to VS-17.1/W9A)

workflows.name: Discount Capture Reconciliation, GL Posting & Audit Trail

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-validate of "validate payable clearance, discount-income posting, and finance-charge posting" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-count of "Finance/GL post discount income" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-review of "review of SCF/dynamic-discounting controls, SoD, and off-balance-sheet…" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-545 (ensure controlled execution — Dynamic Discounting & Early-Payment Operations (PA-105.2).)
- operational: daily reconciliation; operational: platform audit-trail and SoD controls
Pain Points / Risks: - **Posting-error risk**: Discount income/finance charge mis-posted distorts margin (links to VS-101.3) and close; mitigated by daily reconciliation
- **Audit-trail-gap risk**: Missing authorization/reconciliation evidence fails audit; mitigated by platform audit-trail and SoD controls
System Touchpoints: - Dynamic-discounting platform; AP/GL (links to VS-15/VS-17.1); bank reconciliation (links to VS-18.2); audit (links to VS-21)

steps.activity: AP/Treasury reconcile daily: dynamic-discounting platform discount capture vs AP sub-ledger vs bank settlement (links to VS-18.2); validate payable clearance, discount-income posting, and finance-charge posting; resolve breaks via W3383

Finance/GL post discount income (contra COGS or other income per policy) and finance charges to the correct entity GL (links to VS-17.1/W9A); reconcile to the cash forecast impact (links to VS-18.1); support the month-end close

Treasury/AP maintain the audit trail: offer, acceptance, authorization, payment, reconciliation evidence; support Internal Audit (links to VS-21) and external audit review of SCF/dynamic-discounting controls, SoD, and off-balance-sheet classification (links to W3377)
